rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase for Rent-Controlled Units
rules.requirement: If your unit is covered by rent control, your landlord can only raise rent by a set annual percentage, published yearly by the Rent Board.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rent-controlled units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is covered by the Rent Ordinance (rent-controlled)

rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Devices to Set Rents
rules.requirement: Landlords and companies cannot sell or use software/algorithmic tools that use nonpublic competitor rental data to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental units in San Francisco.
rules.penalty: A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action against a violator.
rules.quoted_span: adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024. The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
